entities.name: Frank William La Rue
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frank La Rue is a Guatemalan labor and human rights law expert and served as United Nations Special Rapporteur on the promotion and protection of the right to freedom of opinion and expression, from August 2008 to August 2014.
